name: Glastrier
flavorText: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
description: Glastrier is the Wild Horse Pokémon, an Ice-type first discovered in the Galar region. It is an extremely rare Legendary Pokémon! It stands 7'03" (2.2 m) tall and weighs 1763.7 lbs (800.0 kg). Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
